### God’s Appeal to His People
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/gods-appeal-to-his-people
Passage: 2 Chronicles 36:15-16
Points:
- God persistently sent prophets to Judah because He had compassion on His people and His dwelling place.
- The people repeatedly mocked God's messengers and rejected His words until divine wrath arose beyond remedy.
- The fall of Jerusalem and the Babylonian exile proved that the Lord faithfully fulfills His covenant warnings.
- Even as judgment drew near, God graciously offered opportunities to lessen destruction and preserve life.
- God's warnings and providential discipline reflect His mercy and desire that sinners turn to Him.
